summary: Iteration 45 - App Store readiness fixes verified end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass (16 new iter45 + 12 iter43 regression). New coverage: /api/health 200, /api/auth/apple still rejects malformed token even when authorization_code is supplied (verification happens BEFORE code exchange), authorization_code is optional, _siwa_configured() returns False against the dev .env (KEY_ID + PRIVATE_KEY empty), _apple_revoke_token() short-circuits to False and makes ZERO httpx calls when SIWA is unconfigured or token is empty, _build_apple_client_secret() with a freshly-generated ES256 keypair produces a JWT whose header is {alg: ES256, kid: TESTKEY123} and whose claims contain iss=6XRMF8PK98, sub=com.youbelong.community, aud=https://appleid.apple.com, iat/exp with exp-iat <= 6 months and signature verifies against the public key. DELETE /api/users/me works for a user without apple_refresh_token (200 + ok:true, follow-up /auth/me returns 401). app.json is valid JSON, contains ios.privacyManifests with all 4 declared API categories (UserDefaults/CA92.1, FileTimestamp/C617.1, DiskSpace/E174.1, SystemBootTime/35F9.1), and has NO removed keys (NSUserTrackingUsageDescription, NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, NSContactsUsageDescription, RECORD_AUDIO, READ_CONTACTS, googleServicesFile all absent). usesAppleSignIn=true and expo-apple-authentication plugin still present. Frontend: welcome page renders with Google + Sign Up + Log In (Apple button correctly hidden on web), home page renders BrandLockup + Welcome back Margaret + TODAY'S THOUGHT card, edit-profile page renders, settings Delete Account modal opens with the 'Are you sure? This action cannot be undone' confirmation. No build errors, no red screen, only pre-existing RN-web style deprecation warnings.
action_items: When you obtain the Sign-in-with-Apple .p8 from Apple Developer Portal, populate APPLE_SIWA_KEY_ID and APPLE_SIWA_PRIVATE_KEY in /app/backend/.env (newlines preserved or escaped as \n). The helpers will then exercise the real Apple endpoints automatically on next sign-in; until then they no-op safely.

Real-token happy path for SIWA revoke (POST https://appleid.apple.com/auth/revoke) can only be exercised with a real iOS device + valid SIWA private key + a real Apple Sign-In session — not testable in this environment. Code review of _apple_revoke_token + the call site in self_delete_account is the best we can do here, and both look correct.
critical_code_review_comments: _apple_revoke_token() correctly returns False immediately if _siwa_configured() is False OR token is empty — verified by patching httpx.AsyncClient and confirming no instantiation occurs. Fire-and-forget at the call site is appropriate: a 5xx from Apple should not block local account deletion.

_build_apple_client_secret() reads APPLE_SIWA_PRIVATE_KEY via os.getenv and runs .replace('\\n', '\n') — so both single-line escaped (.env-friendly) and multi-line raw PEM will work. The JWT header explicitly sets alg=ES256 and kid, and the claims map exactly to Apple's required shape. Verified by minting an ES256 keypair in-test and decoding with the public key.

auth_apple() ordering is correct: JWT signature/aud/iss verification (line ~1377) runs BEFORE any call to _apple_exchange_code. That's important because it means a malformed authorization_code from a forged client cannot be exchanged — Apple itself would reject the code, but we don't even reach Apple's endpoint until the identity_token is proven authentic.

self_delete_account() guards the revoke call with `if rt and _siwa_configured()` — exactly the right shape. Logs `apple revoke for user=<id> -> <bool>` on success path, `errored:` on exception path; both branches let the function continue to _hard_delete_user_data so the user's local data is always removed even if Apple is unreachable.

AppleAuthBody.authorization_code is `Optional[str] = None` — Pydantic will accept payloads with or without it, and both the existing-user (line ~1439) and new-user (line ~1487) branches guard on `if body.authorization_code and _siwa_configured()` before calling _apple_exchange_code. Safe.

Frontend chain is wired end-to-end: expo-apple-authentication returns credential.authorizationCode -> appleSignIn.ts (line 58) returns it -> auth.tsx loginWithApple (line 116) accepts it -> api.appleAuth (line 23) POSTs it as authorization_code in JSON body. Field naming is consistent (camelCase on JS side, snake_case on wire). Index.tsx (line 176) threads credential.authorizationCode through. No drops.
app.json privacyManifests structure matches Apple's PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy schema exactly — NSPrivacyAccessedAPIType strings and reason codes are the canonical Apple values. Will satisfy ITMS-91053.

Removed permissions are clean — no orphan code references RECORD_AUDIO / READ_CONTACTS / NSMicrophoneUsageDescription. The decision to drop NSUserTrackingUsageDescription is correct since no ATT-requiring SDK is integrated.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter45_appstore_readiness.py (new — 16 tests covering all the SIWA helpers, /api/auth/apple new payload field, self-delete without refresh-token, and app.json structure)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (welcome / home / edit-profile / settings + delete modal all render cleanly with mobile viewport 375x667)

seed_data_creation: Created one transient real-account user (pwtest_del_<rand>) via POST /api/auth/signup, then deleted it via DELETE /api/users/me in the same test. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When/if APPLE_SIWA_KEY_ID and APPLE_SIWA_PRIVATE_KEY get populated in /app/backend/.env, the test_apple_revoke_token_no_op_when_unconfigured guard `assert server._siwa_configured() is False` will start failing because the helper reads os.getenv every call. At that point either monkeypatch.setenv to empty in the test, or split it into two tests. The /api/auth/apple happy path (real Apple-signed identity_token + auth_code -> 200 + apple_refresh_token stored in user doc) genuinely requires a real iOS dev build + valid Apple Developer team — best left as a manual smoke after TestFlight upload.
rca_of_issue: n/a — this iteration is verification of fixes, not a bug RCA. Three App Store Review blockers (SIWA token revocation on delete, privacy manifest, removed ATT description) and four warnings (unused mic + contacts perms + RECORD_AUDIO + READ_CONTACTS, missing googleServicesFile reference) are now resolved at code level.
